The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.body: The written account describes a routine decision, while the person affected describes the moment their life became harder. One side points to dates, policy, and the language on file; the other points to missed care, panic, or a conversation nobody documented. The Moon puts the lived experience on the record, while Mercury defends the version that can be quoted. The opposition forces the official file to face the experience it failed to capture. A correction may settle the file, but the relationship changes if the human story is treated as evidence that matters less.
